title: Expand hierarchicalMenu root item
body: By default, hierarchicalMenu items are collapsed and user has to click any item to see sub-items as you can see in below screenshot that _Category_ **Electric & Electronic** item collapsed. But as it is the only one root item(which has sub-items) so I want to expand it as soon as page loads so that user don't need to click on the item to see sub-items as below screenshot. Here is the page: https://protenders.com/companies/bodet/products Is it possible?
